content: Real-world OBS/stream-overlay incident: an overlay authenticated its API calls by appending an auth token as a URL query parameter on a GET request; this leaked the token via browser history, server access logs, and Referer headers. Fix was routing through a proper authorization handler and sending the token in a custom header (e.g. X-Overlay-Token) instead of the query string. Directly applicable to any /stream/company/:id OBS browser-source route that needs a token.
